Lesson 10 Warm-up: match pictures with words (工作, 看书, 坐, 桌子, 电脑, 爸爸和妈妈)
桌子上有什么？ (Zhuōzi shang yǒu shénme?) - What are there on the desk?
桌子上有一个电脑和一本书。 (Zhuōzi shang yǒu yí ge diànnǎo hé yì běn shū.) - There is a computer and a book on the desk.
杯子在哪儿？ (Bēizi zài nǎr?) - Where is the cup?
杯子在桌子里。 (Bēizi zài zhuōzi li.) - It's in the desk.
前面那个人叫什么名字？ (Qiánmiàn nàge rén jiào shénme míngzi?) - Who is the person in the front?
她叫王方，在医院工作。 (Tā jiào Wáng Fāng, zài yīyuàn gōngzuò.) - She is Wang Fang. She works in a hospital.
后面那个人呢？ (Hòumiàn nàge rén ne?) - What about the person at the back?
他叫什么名字？ (Tā jiào shénme míngzi?) - What's his name?
他叫谢朋，在商店工作。 (Tā jiào Xiè Péng, zài shāngdiàn gōngzuò.) - He is Xie Peng. He works in a store.
这儿有人吗？ (Zhèr yǒu rén ma?) - Is this seat taken?
没有。 (Méi yǒu.) - No, it isn't.
我能坐这儿吗？ (Wǒ néng zuò zhèr ma?) - Can I sit here?
请坐。 (Qǐng zuò.) - Yes, please.
椅子下面有一只小狗。 (Yǐzi xiàmiàn yǒu yì zhī xiǎo gǒu.) - There is a little dog under the chair.
学校里有一个商店。 (Xuéxiào li yǒu yí ge shāngdiàn.) - There is a store in the school.
桌子上有一个电脑和一本书。 (Zhuōzi shang yǒu yí ge diànnǎo hé yì běn shū.) - There is a computer and a book on the desk.
椅子下面没有小狗。 (Yǐzi xiàmiàn méiyǒu xiǎo gǒu.) - There is no little dog under the chair.
学校里没有商店。 (Xuéxiào li méiyǒu shāngdiàn.) - There is no store in the school.
桌子上没有电脑和书。 (Zhuōzi shang méiyǒu diànnǎo hé shū.) - There is no computer or book on the desk.
我有一个中国朋友和一个美国朋友。 (Wǒ yǒu yí ge Zhōngguó péngyou hé yí ge Měiguó péngyou.) - I have a Chinese friend and an American friend.
我家有三口人，爸爸、妈妈和我。 (Wǒ jiā yǒu sān kǒu rén, bàba, māma hé wǒ.) - There are three people in my family: dad, mom and me.
明天下午我能去商店。 (Míngtiān xiàwǔ wǒ néng qù shāngdiàn.) - I can go to the store tomorrow afternoon.
你能在这儿写你的名字吗？ (Nǐ néng zài zhèr xiě nǐ de míngzi ma?) - Can you write your name here?
我能坐这儿吗？ (Wǒ néng zuò zhèr ma?) - Can I sit here?
请写您的名字。 (Qǐng xiě nín de míngzi.) - Please write your name.
请喝茶。 (Qǐng hē chá.) - Please have some tea.
请坐。 (Qǐng zuò.) - Please sit.
电脑在哪儿？ (Diànnǎo zài nǎr?) - Where is the computer?
书在哪儿？ (Shū zài nǎr?) - Where is the book?
桌子里面有什么？ (Zhuōzi lǐmiàn yǒu shénme?) - What is inside the desk?
哪个人是王方？ (Nǎge rén shì Wáng Fāng?) - Which person is Wang Fang?
哪个人是谢朋？ (Nǎge rén shì Xiè Péng?) - Which person is Xie Peng?
他在________工作。 (Tā zài ________ gōngzuò.) - He works at ________.
我家有三________人。 (Wǒ jiā yǒu sān ________ rén.) - There are three ________ people in my family.
我买一________杯子。 (Wǒ mǎi yī ________ bēizi.) - I buy one ________ cup.

椅子八十________钱。 (Yǐzi bāshí ________ qián.) - A chair costs eighty ________ (money).

单姓 (single-character surname): a family name of one character; most Chinese people have one
复姓 (compound-character surname): a family name of two or more characters, e.g. 欧阳, 上官, 诸葛
Addressing a person by family name + job/profession, e.g. 李老师 (Teacher Li), 王医生 (Doctor Wang)
中国人的名字一般是姓氏在前、名字在后，比如“李月”、“谢朋”、“王方”。 - A Chinese name starts with the family name and ends with the given name, e.g. 李月, 谢朋 and 王方, where 李, 谢, 王 are family names and 月, 朋, 方 are given names.
中国人的姓有5000多个，现在常见的大概有200多个。 - There are over 5,000 Chinese family names, among which more than 200 are commonly seen.
“张”、“王”、“李”、“赵”是中国人最常见的姓。 - 张, 王, 李 and 赵 are the most common Chinese family names.
一个字的姓叫作单姓，大多数中国人的姓是单姓。 - Family names with only one character are single-character surnames; most Chinese people have a single-character surname.
两个字或者两个字以上的姓叫作复姓，比如“欧阳”、“上官”、“诸葛”。 - Surnames with two or more characters are compound-character surnames, such as 欧阳, 上官 and 诸葛.
在称呼时，可以用一个人的姓加上这个人的工作或者职业。 - A person can be addressed with his/her family name followed by his/her job or profession.
李月姓李，是老师，我们可以称呼她“李老师”。 - 李月 is a teacher, so we can call her 李老师 (Teacher Li).
王方姓王，是医生，我们可以称呼她“王医生”。 - 王方 is a doctor, so we can call her 王医生 (Doctor Wang).
Lesson 11 Warm-up: match clock pictures with times (5:00, 2:00, 9:45, 12:00, 3:05, 6:30, 10:10)
现在几点？ (Xiànzài jǐ diǎn?) - What's the time now?
现在十点十分。 (Xiànzài shí diǎn shí fēn.) - It's ten past ten.
中午几点吃饭？ (Zhōngwǔ jǐ diǎn chī fàn?) - When shall we have our lunch?
十二点吃饭。 (Shí'èr diǎn chī fàn.) - At twelve o'clock.
星期一 (xīngqī yī) - Monday
星期五 (xīngqī wǔ) - Friday
爸爸什么时候回家？ (Bàba shénme shíhou huí jiā?) - When is father coming home?
下午五点。 (Xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn.) - At five o'clock in the afternoon.
我们什么时候去看电影？ (Wǒmen shénme shíhou qù kàn diànyǐng?) - When are we going to see the movie?
六点三十分。 (Liù diǎn sānshí fēn.) - At half past six.
我星期一去北京。 (Wǒ xīngqī yī qù Běijīng.) - I'll go to Beijing next Monday.
你想在北京住几天？ (Nǐ xiǎng zài Běijīng zhù jǐ tiān?) - How long will you stay in Beijing?
住三天。 (Zhù sān tiān.) - For three days.
星期五前能回家吗？ (Xīngqī wǔ qián néng huí jiā ma?) - Can you come back before Friday?
能。 (Néng.) - Yes, I can.
上午 (shàngwǔ) - morning, before noon (am)
下午 (xiàwǔ) - afternoon (pm)
零 (líng) - zero
两 (liǎng) - two (used for 2 o'clock: 两点, not 二点)
Grammar: 点 and 分 time pattern (……点……分; bigger unit before smaller unit; 点 for whole hours, e.g. 九点, 五点三十分, 两点零五分)
Grammar: 2 o'clock is 两点 (liǎng diǎn), not 二点 (èr diǎn)
Grammar: 上午/下午 + 点(分) pattern to distinguish morning from afternoon (e.g. 上午八点, 下午三点十分)
妈妈六点做饭。 (Māma liù diǎn zuò fàn.) - Mom cooks at six o'clock.
李老师上午八点去学校。 (Lǐ lǎoshī shàngwǔ bā diǎn qù xuéxiào.) - Teacher Li goes to school at eight in the morning.
七点我吃饭。 (Qī diǎn wǒ chī fàn.) - I eat at seven o'clock.
中午十二点我们回家。 (Zhōngwǔ shí'èr diǎn wǒmen huí jiā.) - We go home at twelve noon.
下午五点他们去看电影。 (Xiàwǔ wǔ diǎn tāmen qù kàn diànyǐng.) - They go to see a movie at five in the afternoon.
你什么时候去学校？ (Nǐ shénme shíhou qù xuéxiào?) - When do you go to school?
八点前。 (Bā diǎn qián.) - Before eight o'clock.
你什么时候回北京？ (Nǐ shénme shíhou huí Běijīng?) - When do you go back to Beijing?
星期六前。 (Xīngqī liù qián.) - Before Saturday.
（你）星期五前能回家吗？ ((Nǐ) xīngqī wǔ qián néng huí jiā ma?) - Can you come home before Friday?
能。 (Néng.) - Yes, I can.
